name: Xplicit Designz LLC
old_description: Dustin is awesome to work with and very honest and professional and his quality of work is second to none! Highly recommend!
about:
Xplicit Designz LLC operates from Harrington, Delaware. The business was founded by Dustin, who serves as the lead artist for custom paint and airbrush work.

The company sells racing safety equipment including helmets (Bell M8, BR8, XR7, XD7 series), gloves (Velocita Bones and Stars), shoes (Velocita Ultimate), apparel (Z-25 Dirt Jacket), and accessories such as tearoffs (XStack™), helmet restraints, and neck supports. In addition to retail, Xplicit Designz provides custom paint and airbrush services, primarily for helmet customization.

The customer base spans motorsports disciplines including closed‑cockpit road racing, off‑road and dirt racing, and karting. Buyers range from individual racers to teams seeking SFI‑rated safety gear and personalized helmet finishes.

Customer testimonials featured on the site emphasize Dustin’s honesty, professionalism, attention to detail, and quick turnaround on custom orders.
